Part 1: The Twins of Dassom
Narrator
On the continent of Hackenia, six elements shape the cities and the wilds. In Dassom, Kayla and Hilam entrust you with a mission.
Two new twins have been reported far from Dassom. We want you to go meet them and bring them back safely.
But before you leave… a little game of dice will put us in the mood!
I'll use a starter deck for your first game, otherwise it wouldn't be a real game.
Lesser Hydrelithe
Pack of hungry wolves
That was fun! The result hardly matters: you understood the essentials and you're ready for what's next.
It's time to go. The road to the new twins begins in the north, through the Tender Wood.
Part 1 complete — The Tender Wood is now accessible. Reward: 50 Bubbles.
End the part
Part 2: The Tender Wood
Good news! From this part on, you can play with your own deck. You can build it in your collection before the duel; if you don't have a valid one yet, the game will offer to complete it.
The Tender Wood
The adventurers enter the Tender Wood and decide to make a short stop under the trees.
Eberien
Kala, look at this bush. These berries seem nourishing. Let's take a few to examine later.
Good idea. Let's keep them carefully, without tasting them for now.
Suddenly, all the colors disappear. The forest seems frozen in a scene from another adventure.
Parallel memory • The Tender Wood
Violette
But why did you eat them all?!?
Mirahel stares at her wide-eyed, cheeks full of berries. He tries to answer, then gives up, clearly embarrassed.
Mirahel
Dédé the Tinkerer
Were you at least planning to leave us one? Ha ha!
The vision fades and the colors return to the Tender Wood.
We're a bit bored during this stop… Grimgors, up for a dice duel?
Gladly! But I don't intend to let you win.
Lone spider
Good game! You won this rematch.
The group hits the road again. Above the trees, the adventurers spot a thin smoke: it seems to come from a farmer's cabin. Part 2 stops here. On first success: 50 Bubbles and a booster.
End part 2
Well played! But this time, the victory is mine.
To continue on the road, you will have to restart the Tender Wood part and win the duel.
Back to the chapter
Part 3: The Cabin at the Two Paths
Following the smoke seen in the distance, the adventurers arrive at the cabin. It stands at the fork: one path goes left, the other right.
The old farmer's cabin
Old farmer
Dwarf horse
An old farmer, sitting by his fence under a straw hat, sees the adventurers approach. His dwarf horse barely lifts its head.
Ah no, I'm not buying anything, you hear!
Rest assured, we're not selling anything. We're on a mission. We're just looking for our way.
The old man studies them for a moment. His shoulders relax and his voice becomes less brusque.
On a mission? You're here for Berdésa, then? There seems to be trouble there…
During this exchange, Kala and Bolduc have approached the dwarf horse. They pet it gently; the little horse welcomes their attention without worry.
Well, you're a lot less wary than your owner!
We'll go through Berdésa. Thank you for warning us.
The group thanks the farmer and prepares to take the road to Berdésa. But, for a moment, the colors of the scene fade…
Another adventure, in the same place. Violette sits down right next to the old man. He immediately shifts over on his seat.
Parallel memory • The old farmer's cabin
Hey… could you leave me a bit of room?
I just wanted to sit. Fine, I'll move over.
Say, your horse… wouldn't you like to give it to us? For free, I mean.
No. He stays here, my horse.
Even if I promise we'll take very, very good care of him?
I said no! And stop insisting!
The farmer starts to shake, exasperated. This time, the group understands it's best to leave it at that.
Dédé, let's go. Without the horse.
They leave the old farmer and his horse in peace, then take the road to the twins' cave directly, without a detour through Berdésa.
Parallel memory • Toward the twins' cave
The colors return. It is indeed the current adventurers walking toward Berdésa now. The first wooden houses appear by the roadside.
Berdésa
The group enters the village. What is happening there? The rest remains to be discovered. Part 3 complete — 50 Bubbles and a booster on first success.
End part 3
Part 4: The Light of the Mines
In Berdésa, a villager calls out to them: miners are in danger! Grimgors and Jhimm immediately take the lead.
At the mine entrance, overturned carts and broken pickaxes litter the floor. Two blue torches light a single wooden door.
The Mines of Berdésa
That light… Wait, I'll take a torch.
The voice of the torch
Accept my challenge and you will see clearer than ever.
Then show me the way.
Accept the challenge
Elemental spring
Communication mirror
Superior Hydrelithe
I see the galleries… as if I had already been here.
Two seconds later, Grimgors breaks down the wooden door. The group rushes into the passage.
A horde of black spiders blocks their way. Together, the adventurers push them back without difficulty.
There! A white spider… It's fleeing into that other tunnel.
The small silhouette vanishes into the darkness. End of part 4 — a booster and 50 Bubbles on first success.
End part 4
The light remains veiled. Come back and try the challenge.
Retry the duel
Part 5: The End of the Mine
In the galleries, Kala watches the white spiders. They keep away from the miners without ever attacking them.
Wait… white spiders are harmless to humans! No need to fight them. Let's take care of the miners.
I'll take them to safety. Stay together and follow me! I'll be back as soon as they're safe.
Jhimm helps the miners along and quickly leads them out of the mine. Once everyone is safe, he goes back to find his friends.
They're safe. You can count on me for what comes next!
At the last recess, an enormous black spider rises before the group. This one is nothing like the peaceful white spiders: it blocks their way.
Giant black spider
Then we'll fight our way through!
Face the spider
The giant spider
Bolduc brings his club down on the spider's huge head. The shock echoes through the whole gallery: the creature finally collapses.
The adventurers rejoin, in the village, the miners Jhimm put to safety. They are finally safe.
At the inn, a hot meal and a night's rest restore their strength. Then they take the road again toward the twins' cave, the passage leading to the lake.
End part 5
Let's catch our breath… and go back in!
Part 6: An Unexpected Fall
The adventurers continue toward the twins' cave. Suddenly, an enormous CRACK rings out above them!
A portal has opened in the sky. Something falls out of it and vanishes behind the trees in a crash of branches.
Someone might need us! Quick, let's go see!
Without a second thought, the adventurers run to the spot of the fall. As they approach, they hear a voice: "Help! Somebody help!"
The cries come from behind a tree. A poor victim is surrounded there by a pack of hungry wolves.
Hold on! We'll drive off these wolves!
Face the wolves
The wolves finally flee. The adventurers rush behind the tree to check that the victim is unharmed.
Are you hurt?… By all the stars, it's a toilet brush!
A talking toilet brush, yes! Sir Broom, at your service! Thank you, I really thought I'd end up between the jaws of those wolves!
The group stands agape for a moment before this strange survivor. Then the colors fade: a memory from another adventure appears…
In this black-and-white memory, Violette, Mirahel and Dédé the Tinkerer have also just saved Sir Broom from the wolves.
Sir Broom, faithful servant! I owe you a great debt!
Wait… did we just save a talking toilet brush?!
Violette, Mirahel and Dédé the Tinkerer look at each other, then burst out laughing. Sir Broom doesn't know where to put his bristles!
The memory fades and the colors return. Sir Broom is still there, safe and sound, among the adventurers.
Come with us, Sir Broom. You'll be safer in good company.
With great pleasure! And, if possible, far from the wolves!
Sir Broom joins the group. The adventurers finally set off again toward the twins' cave.
End part 6
The wolves are still here. Let's not give up, this person is counting on us!
Part 6 bis: New Faces
With Sir Broom saved, the adventurers get ready to hit the road. The sound of footsteps holds them back: three travelers approach between the trees.
Pennedra gives them a friendly wave. Ven stares at them, chin raised. Beside them, Frolgor watches the scene without a word.
Hello there! I'm Pennedra. This is Ven and Frolgor.
Yes, introductions will do. What are you doing here, exactly?
We're just passing through. We still have a bit of road ahead.
Grimgors puffs out his chest and stands tall: their group knows how to defend itself. Ven doesn't seem very impressed. Frolgor stays silent.
Passing through? Where are you from? And why hang around in these woods?
From Berdésa. We helped some miners who were in danger.
You were in the area too? You didn't hear what was going on in the mine?
Yes, of course. But we had more important things to do.
The adventurers exchange jaded looks. Ah yes… right. So they had left the miners to fend for themselves.
jaded
More important. I see.
Frolgor makes no comment. His gaze moves calmly from Ven to the adventurers.
Since you seem so sure of yourselves, we'll settle this with a game of dice. I challenge you. No backing out.
Leave it to me. I'll show him what our group is worth.
Face Ven with Grimgors
There. We still have road ahead. Safe travels.
The duel over, the adventurers resume their way toward the twins' cave.
End part 6 bis
A rematch. I'm not done with you.
Passing the old farmer's cabin again, the adventurers notice he has vanished. Only his little dwarf horse remains, grazing peacefully by the fence.
Bolduc has an idea. To talk to the horse, he decides to turn himself into a horse. Even in this form, you can't miss his red mane and long braided beard!
Horse-Bolduc
Huh? I'm Jordan. Got any carrots?
No, but I can give you berries if you like. I'll find you carrots later.
Jordan gladly accepts the berries and starts nibbling them, delighted to finally have something to eat.
Berry bushes
Why don't you come with us! We'll take you back to Dassom. Your master may be there.
Jordan nods and decides to follow the adventurers to Dassom, hoping to find his master there.
End the bonus
Part 7: Crossing the Cave
The adventurers finally arrive at the door of the twins' cave. Two carved faces frame an inscription.
The twins' cave
Give up and be reborn. That's what the door says…
Give up what? Our possessions? Our certainties? There must be a meaning to this riddle.
They think for a long time. Attempts follow one another, but the door remains still.
Maybe you must be without all your finery to pass this door?
Ah! Finally a riddle I like!
Really… everything? Fine. If it's the only way through…

The adventurers set down their weapons, then their clothes, and find themselves naked before the door. Bolduc is delighted; Jhimm much less so. The others remain almost stone-faced. Instantly, a light wraps around them and teleports them inside the dungeon.
The group finds itself fully equipped: clothes, armor and weapons are back in place, as if nothing had been removed.
Give up to be reborn… You were right, Sir Broom.
The crossing begins. A tile triggers spikes; a reassuring passage hides a pit. The adventurers foil these clever, sometimes downright sneaky traps by advancing carefully.
Don't trust the easiest path. Look at the marks on the ground before taking a step.
At the end of the passage, three ghostly soldiers block their way. Probably former adventurers who perished during this very crossing…
They won't let us through. Stay together!
Face the ghostly soldiers
Ghostly soldiers
The three ghostly soldiers fade away. Silence returns to the cave.
A luminous portal opens before the adventurers. Its light illuminates the stone: the crossing of the cave is complete.
End part 7
The passage is still guarded. Let's catch our breath before trying again.
Part 8: Caleizis and the Pink Lake
Before jumping in, let's try with a pebble.
Grimgors throws a pebble through the portal. It disappears into the light… and does not come back.
I could stick my head through, just to look at the other side…
Finally, Bolduc reaches out. The moment he touches the portal he is sucked in! His friends don't hesitate and follow right after him.
They all find themselves in a large hall lit by bluish torches. The sculptures on the walls depict pairs of figures: a temple of the twins.
The temple of the twins
Another room, on the left… and the exit over there, about thirty meters away.
A huge whirlwind of violet wisps unfurls in the hall. Caleizis appears in the middle of this light, like a mirage.
There you are at last. You carry far more than your weapons… I know the stories you prefer to keep quiet.
She mentions names, places and precise moments of their lives. Some awaken an old pain; others, a resentment they thought buried. She knows far too much.
Enough. How do you know all this?
They try to react, but something in the air paralyzes them all. Impossible to take a step. Caleizis's power clearly exceeds theirs.
Well? Has no one anything to say?
Challenge Caleizis to a dice duel
Keep silent
No… It's not possible! You…!
Caleizis loses her temper. Tears run down her cheeks; her wisps tear apart and she vanishes, furious and in tears.
I can move again. Is everyone okay?
Let's go see that room on the left before leaving.
The adventurers search the ritual room. Two beautiful statues stand there, facing each other.
The ritual room
Two statues in the ritual room and the elemental ice spring
At the back… an elemental ice spring!
Blue crystals rise above a luminous water. The ice spring lights the sculptures with a cold glow.
At last, they leave the cave. A magnificent panorama stretches before them: the pink lake glitters between the mountains under the moonlight.
Panorama of the pink lake under a pink moon between the mountains
After the traps and this unsettling encounter, the adventurers pause for a moment to contemplate the lake. Part 8 ends here.
End part 8
Caleizis has the upper hand. Part 8 must be restarted from the beginning.
Restart part 8
Your silence is quite disappointing…
A little offended at receiving no answer, Caleizis finally vanishes into her wisps.
Part 9: The Guardians of the Lake
The adventurers finally reach the famous pink lake. This is where they should find the new twins. Yet no one awaits them.
Not a silhouette… Let's stay in the area.
The woods run along the lake on the right. We can spend the night there while watching the shore.
The shore of the pink lake
They settle between the trees, close enough to the water to spot a possible arrival in the distance. They organize a night watch.
I'll take the first shift. Get some rest.
Jhimm's watch passes calmly. Only the wind in the branches and the lapping of the lake disturb the silence.
My turn. Go to sleep, I'll keep an eye on the lake.
Kala suddenly hears voices in her head. Soft, insistent, they invite her to enter the lake… to join them beneath the surface.
Kala… Do you hear these voices too?
Eberien has just woken up. The same charm takes hold of him. Despite their efforts, both feel drawn toward the depths of the lake.
Wake up! Help us! Something is pulling us into the water!
Their friends rush out of the camp. The guardians begin to emerge from the lake, followed by two lesser hydrelithes.
Three red guardians and two blue hydrelithes emerge from the pink lake, in chibi version
In the distance, Caleizis's laughter rings out in the night, as if she were pleased with what unfolds before them.
Hold on! We're here!
Face the creatures of the lake
The guardians of the lake
The creatures vanish into the pink waters. The charm breaks: Kala and Eberien finally regain control of their movements.
You're with us. Let's move away from the edge.
A huge bubble slowly rises from the lake. Iridescent reflections run over its surface. Inside rest the new twins.
The new twins in their bubble
There they are… We've finally found them.
As the adventurers approach the new twins to bring them to dry land, the bubble gently bursts and lets them retrieve them.
The bound new twins
End part 9
The creatures still hold the shore. They must be defeated to free Kala and Eberien.
Part 10: The Elemental Bonds
The new twins are finally on dry land. Yet magic vines still bind their arms and legs.
Ice crystals on the young man… and a crackling light on the young woman. These bonds are no ordinary plants.
One good swing of the axe and we can leave!
On contact with the vines, Bolduc's axe is violently repelled. It slips from his hands and flies off before landing farther along the shore.
Well… They didn't like that.
Grimgors and Kala try to pull a vine away from the young man. Their fingers instantly frost over: they pull their hands back, unable to force the bonds.
Let's try with small amounts of energy, far from their skin.
The first attempts make the vines vibrate without breaking them. Then a spark of fire softens a blue crystal. The adventurers understand: an opposing element is needed.
Fire has the upper hand over ice. And earth should dissipate these threads of lightning!
